audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the page never names a single Riven ability. Everything was 'her Q', 'her E shield', 'W stun', with no cooldowns attached.
audit.why: The decisive numbers are Broken Wings (Q) on a flat 13s covering all three casts, Ki Burst (W) 11/10/9/8/7s — her only hard CC, Valor (E) 10/9/8/7/6s for the dash and the shield, and Blade of the Exile (R) 120/90/60s granting AD, range and one Wind Slash. Broken Wings being one 13s cooldown for the whole three-cast chain is the fact that makes 'kite it out and step in' real advice.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into the level chart and the do/don't lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was scored Lucian though whys[0] says 'you are both weak at level 1'; Levels 4-5 and First item were 'Skill' though whys[3] says 'you out-trade her here' and whys[5] says your double-shot still beats her; 2+ items was Lucian though whys[6] says she out-scales you hard.
audit.why: 69.23% win rate and the packet chart reads Skill, then Lucian through stage 6, then Riven — exactly matching the prose.
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0].side -> Skill; win[3]/phases[3].side and win[5]/phases[5].side -> Lucian; win[6]/phases[6].side -> Riven.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..6].why were generic Lucian boilerplate and named no spike on either side.
audit.why: The real curve: your window is every Broken Wings downtime through 4-5, your first item still out-damages her pre-Eclipse, and her spike is Blade of the Exile plus items at 2+ — where its cooldown has fallen to 60s.
audit.corrected: Each stage now carries the ability and the number that decides it.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Both level 1s are weak and Valor's shield blunts your Q poke — last-hit cleanly and set up your level 2 spike.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Ki Burst (Stun) — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: You out-trade her: Broken Wings is 13s, so once all three casts are spent she cannot reach you for a rotation.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: The Culling executes her low HP once Valor's shield and Broken Wings are spent chasing you.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: Your first item still beats her pre-Eclipse damage — keep forcing trades while Ki Burst (7-11s) is down.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile is 60s late and her Q3 knockback into Ki Burst deletes you — end before her item spikes.

edits.before: The stun glues her combo together — bait it before fighting. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s and it is her only hard CC — commit the moment she throws it away.

edits.before: Riven whiffs Ki Burst (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Valor shields her every 6-10s — poke through it, then commit.

edits.before: That is Riven’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Broken Wings is a 13s cooldown for all three casts — count them, then step in.

notes: Riven's most exploitable property for Lucian is that Broken Wings is a single 13-second cooldown covering the entire three-cast chain — spend it and she has no gap-closer but Valor for the better part of ten seconds. That was absent from the page and is now the basis of the Levels 4-5 line. Note the page describes 'Q3 knockup'; Riot's text says the third hit knocks back, and the kit's flag says knockup — the existing wording was left alone rather than changed on a flag/description disagreement. diff HARD against 'Even matchup 5.5/10' in the prose, with a 69.23% win rate, is a pre-existing inconsistency worth one deliberate call.
